newsitem.title: JAPAN: JAX to change name to Fahren Tokyo KK.
newsitem.headline: JAX to change name to Fahren Tokyo KK.

text.p: JAX Ltd, which sells Volkswagen AG and Audi AG cars in Japan, said on Friday it would change its name to Fahren Tokyo KK on November 1.
JAX is owned 66.67 percent by Volkswagen Group Japan KK (VGJ), the Japanese unit of Volkswagen AG.
The name change will be officially approved at a board meeting on March 28.
JAX has 14 sales outlets in the Tokyo area.
Volkswagen and Audi cars are also sold in Japan through VGJ's 82 Fahren dealerships, and 130 outlets of DUO, Toyota Motor's sales subsidiary for the German cars.
DUO will open a new outlet on March 1 in Iwakuni, western Japan, a VGJ spokesman said.
Sales of Volkswagen and Audi cars in Japan rose a steep 31.5 percent in calendar 1996 from a year earlier to 60,306 vehicles.
